question: Can the reduction stage reach 3500 triangles without hand-selected head/paw protection and preserve the source appearance?
geometry_method: Service basic decimation; local uniform scale/translation restores source bounds. No further local shape changes.
material_failure: Source metallicFactor=0 was omitted in basic output; default factor 1 with nearly white metallic B channel made the dielectric fur metallic. Specular extension also missing; base image became JPEG and roughness map 1024 instead of 2048.
material_repairs_compared: Copy source metallic/specular scalars, flat shading, keep service textures
Copy source shader and deterministically rebake base color/roughness into current UV, flat shading
selection_reason: Rebaked candidate is closer to source in all four measured views and has cleaner facial color. Both corrections use the same general rule without per-cat masks; rebake retained for this already-textured input, not declared mandatory before future texturing.
metric_scope: RGB change from source within overlapping cat silhouettes; not photo identity or cat.png similarity

sampled_surface_distance.scope: World-space vertices and triangle centroids after the recorded uniform scale/translation; not continuous Hausdorff maximum or deformation validation

manual_review: Hero, face, opposite and back-high inspected. White fur color restored; existing flank folds, facial shape and photo-identity uncertainty remain.
automation_scope: One aligned single-mesh/single-material source. Model-specific manual protection was removed from this stage. Source anatomy/texture decisions and review still involve humans; unseen-cat validation not run.
not_passed: Low Poly Animated Cats animation adaptation
